$comment: Shared cursor codec vectors. Both implementations must reproduce every cursor string below exactly. Read by the Node suite (apps/api-node/src/common/pagination/cursor.spec.ts) and by the Java port (task 5.3). Format specified in docs/cursor-format.md. Regenerate with tests/fixtures/.gen-cursor-vectors.mjs.
format: base64url, unpadded, of {"v":<sortValue>,"i":<id>} with no whitespace

vectors.name: newest
vectors.note: An RFC 3339 millisecond timestamp, as the newest sort produces.

vectors.name: price
vectors.note: min_price_cents as a string, never a JSON number.

vectors.name: price-zero
vectors.note: Zero must not become an empty string or be omitted.

vectors.name: name-thai
vectors.sortValue: เสื้อยืดคอกลม ผ้าฝ้ายออร์แกนิก
vectors.note: The case that breaks a JSON library configured to escape non-ASCII. Must be raw UTF-8.

vectors.name: name-thai-tone-marks
vectors.sortValue: กางเกงขาสั้นผ้าฝ้าย
vectors.note: Combining vowels and tone marks: multi-byte sequences that must survive byte-identically.

vectors.name: name-latin
vectors.note: Plain ASCII, the easy case, included so a failure here localises the bug quickly.

vectors.name: quote-in-value
vectors.note: The quote is escaped, and nothing else about the string changes.

vectors.name: empty-value
vectors.note: An empty sort value is still a valid cursor.

vectors.name: emoji
vectors.note: Outside the BMP: a surrogate pair, where per-code-unit iteration would split the character.
